gloss: easily bored; fickle; having a short attention span

definitions.gloss: easily bored; fickle; quick to lose interest
definitions.explanation: Describes a personality trait of getting bored or losing interest quickly. Used to characterize someone who starts things enthusiastically but soon tires of them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{飽|あ}きっぽい。
{飽|あ}きっぽい⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直|なお}したい。
examples.english: I want to fix my fickle personality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{飽|あ}きっぽい⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{向|む}かない→向く：02304_muku⟧。
examples.english: Children get bored easily, so long movies aren't suited for them.

notes:
Describes someone who loses interest in things quickly — the kind of person who picks up hobbies but drops them soon after. It carries a mildly negative nuance, suggesting a lack of perseverance.

FORMS:
⟦{飽|あ}きる→飽きる：01815_akiru⟧ (to get tired of) + ⟦っぽい→っぽい：06781_ppoi⟧ (tendency suffix). The ⟦っぽい→っぽい：06781_ppoi⟧ suffix indicates a habitual tendency or characteristic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飽|あ}きっぽい⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: fickle personality
- {飽|あ}きっぽい⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: someone who gets bored easily
- {飽|あ}きっぽくて⟦{続|つづ}かない→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: too fickle to stick with something

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{三日坊主|みっかぼうず}→三日坊主：06021_mikkabouzu⟧: someone who can't stick with anything (literally "three-day monk") — emphasizes inability to continue, while {飽|あ}きっぽい focuses on the tendency to lose interest
- ⟦{気|き}まぐれ→気まぐれ：07319_kimagure⟧: whimsical, capricious — broader meaning covering unpredictable behavior, not just boredom
